notes.title: Pulling No Punches is out now on MacOS
notes.notes:
QUByte Interactive, in partnership with Braindead Broccoli, is pleased to announce that Pulling no Punches is out now on Mac. This version launched on Steam for the price of $9.90 USD.

Pulling no Punches is a classic beat’em up game with frame-by-frame animations, where players will try to survive a fictional pandemic in a city filled with madness and denial. The game includes 4 playable characters with unique unlockable moves, extremely detailed environments and local co-op multiplayer for up to 4 players.

The game follows the fictional story of a global pandemic that engulfed the world and is being ignored by fanatics who do not believe that the disease is real. It is up to the main characters, 4 common citizens adequately protected with gloves and masks, to deal with these fanatics and solve the situation with the force of their own fists.

notes.title: Patch 1.03 - Achievements Fix
notes.notes:
[h1]The patch notes about achievements below might contain spoilers.[/h1]

[b]Achievements fix:[/b]
Achievements fixed with [u]full retroactivity[/u] (they will be triggered in case you have already done the objectives before. Just enter the Home Menu of the game to unlock):
[list]
[*] “Anger Released”: Unlock every move with Laura
[*] “Long live science!”: Unlock every move with Nina
[*] “I Goth the Power”: Unlock every move with Olga
[*] “Pain and Gain”: Unlock every move with Lola
[*] “Go Tell Your Friends”: Reach 100% of game progress in one Profile
[*] “Thought it was over?”: Defeat Nucleoroking (this was bugged for a small percentage of users)
[/list]

Achievements fixed with [u]partial retroactivity[/u] (they will be triggered in case you have already done the objectives before. Just enter the Home Menu of the game to unlock. However, some players will need to do the objective again, depending on their save history)
[list]
[*] “Exorcist”: Finish the Bonus Stage in Chapter II in 1st place
[/list]

Achievements fixed [u]without retroactivity[/u] (need to be attained in game):
[list]
[*] “Five Birds, One Special”: Hit 5 enemies with a single Special move
[/list]

[b]Other fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some percentage of players getting invisible when entering the final boss fight, forcing a checkpoint reset
[*] Some typo adjustments in the Bestiary (Extras Menu)
[/list]

notes.title: We have been crowdfunded!
notes.notes:
[b]Thank you to all the fans who are making this happen![/b]

Our 45-day crowdfunding campaign has come to an end, raising around BRL 53,000 (1,000% of our original goal) with the support of 1,271 amazing backers.

Due to the stretch goals being reached, we are adding a bunch of content when the game releases in the second semester of 2021!

[list]
[*]4 playable characters in total, each with their own fighting styles, unlockable moves and specials
[*]Up to 4-player multiplayer co-op
[*]More weapons to use
[*]Breakable items, interactive obstacles in the environment
[*]Bonus stages (minigames when checkpoints are reached)
[*]We'll develop the game for MacOS and consoles! (dates do not apply -- our release plan is not ready yet)
[/list]

In the meantime, try out our free demo here on Steam to see what the fuss is all about!
